Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Do I have to book before coming?
Appointments are recommended, especially for first-time visitors. However, we may accept walk-ins depending on availability. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
I'd like to make an appointment.
You can book through the online reservation form on our website. If you'd prefer to arrange it by phone, I can have a staff member call you back. Would you like that?
By phone, please.
Of course. May I have your name, please?
It's Yamada.
Thank you, Yamada. Could you please provide your full name?
Taro.
Thank you, Taro Yamada. May I have a phone number where our staff can reach you?
Excuse me, I'm not sure I caught all of that. Could you give me the phone number once more, please?
Thank you. Let me confirm. Your name is Taro Yamada, and your phone number is zero nine zero, one two three four, five six seven eight. Is that correct?
The last part is 5679.
Thank you for the correction. Let me confirm again. Your name is Taro Yamada, and your phone number is zero nine zero, one two three four, five six seven nine. Is that correct?
No, that's wrong.
Excuse me, I'm not sure I caught all of that. Could you give me the phone number once more, please?
Thank you. Let me confirm. Your name is Taro Yamada, and your phone number is zero nine zero, one two three four, five six seven eight. Is that correct?
Yes, that's right.
